inputs.text: Calling support for women, households and farmers “giveaways” shifts blame onto people who need help rather than confronting the insecurity that makes public support necessary. Doubling women’s monthly aid to Rs 2,000, offering Rs 8,000 household coupons and providing free motor pumpsets can help people meet immediate needs; that is not the opposite of self-reliance. The real test is whether government also builds secure, decent work and shares the gains from FDI and AI development fairly. Jobs matter, but they shouldn’t be used to dismiss essential support or leave vulnerable families to fend for themselves.
